# CBRE Group, Inc. Announces Pricing of $500 Million Senior Notes due 2032 and $500 Million Senior Notes due 2037


October 27, 2026 6:21 pm EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_9fc126ae7c09a4841cb52d0213e70f57/cbre/news/2026-10-27_CBRE_Group_Inc_Announces_Pricing_of_500_Million_272.pdf)


DALLAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE:CBRE) (the “Company”) today announced the pricing of the offering of $500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.650% Senior Notes due 2032 (the “2032 Notes”) and $500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.900% Senior Notes due 2037 (the “2037 Notes” and, together with the 2032 Notes, the “Notes”).


The 2032 Notes will have an interest rate of 5.650% per annum and are being issued at a price equal to 99.424% of their face value. The 2037 Notes will have an interest rate of 5.900% per annum and are being issued at a price equal to 97.872% of their face value.


The Company’s wholly owned subsidiary, CBRE Services, Inc., will issue each series of Notes, which will be guaranteed on a full and unconditional basis by the Company. Each series of Notes is expected to settle on November 5, 2026, subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions.


The Company estimates that the net proceeds from the offering will be approximately $980.2 million, after deducting the underwriters’ discount, but before estimated offering expenses. The Company intends to use the net proceeds for general corporate purposes, including but not limited to the repayment of borrowings under its commercial paper program, and to fund its acquisition of Onnec Group Limited.


Wells Fargo Securities, LLC, BofA Securities, Inc., HSBC Securities (USA) Inc. and J.P. Morgan Securities LLC are acting as joint book-running managers for the offering of the Notes.


The Notes are being offered pursuant to an effective shelf registration statement that the Company previously filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”). The offering of the Notes is being made only by means of a prospectus supplement and accompanying base prospectus, which may be obtained for free by visiting EDGAR on the SEC’s website at[www.sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/) . About CBRE Group, Inc.


CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE:CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm (based on 2025 revenue) and a premier provider of critical infrastructure services.
